# Pavan Kumar Reddipalli

> Technical Lead and Senior Node.js developer with 11+ years of experience building scalable backends, real-time products and cloud platforms.

Pavan Kumar Reddipalli is a backend engineer and technical lead based in Visakhapatnam, India. He works across Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, AWS, Microsoft Azure and React.js.

## Product lab

- [MediCore](https://medicore-hospital-dmlx.onrender.com): live hospital management system with patients, appointments, beds, pharmacy, labs, billing and role-based staff access. [Source](https://github.com/pavankumar501/medicore).
- [Scholara](https://github.com/pavankumar501/scholara): school management platform with admin, teacher, student and parent portals, attendance, timetables, exams, fees and announcements.
- [Billora](https://github.com/pavankumar501/billora): retail POS and billing system with barcode checkout, GST receipts, inventory, purchases, customers and reports.

## Selected work

- [DealsNavi](https://dealsnavi.com/): live Amazon and Flipkart price comparison with price history, drop alerts, coupons, cashback and bank offers. Built end-to-end after July 2026.
- Cureka: healthcare eCommerce platform with Node.js, MySQL, AWS and multiple payment gateways.
- TMILL: supply chain management platform with Node.js, React, PostgreSQL and Microsoft Azure.
- celebKonect: celebrity engagement and commerce platform with Socket.IO and Firebase notifications.
- Flikster: movie-related eCommerce and entertainment backend on AWS.
- Telesur: telecom speech-quality reporting with AngularJS, MongoDB and Kendo UI.
- HRMS & Timesheet: enterprise HR platform with attendance, payroll, leave and immigration modules.

## Additional enterprise work

- Microsoft Word Legal Add-in: document automation for law firms, including Table of Contents and Table of Authorities generation.
- Admin dashboards and analytics: enterprise reporting with charts, pagination and a SQL-to-MongoDB migration.
- Notification and workflow automation: email, SMS and push logging with approval workflows, audit logs and activity tracking.
